$comment: Trevean Spice NFC. Content field specification.
The single source of truth for: what a complete blend page needs, who owns each field,
what shape and length it has to be, and whether it blocks publish.
Three tools read this file and nothing else defines these facts twice:
tools/content-readiness.mjs  reports which fields are still placeholder,
tools/validate-intake.mjs    checks a client submission before we accept it,
CONTENT-INTAKE-SPECIFICATION.md is written from it by hand and must agree with it.
Field types, lengths and enums are taken from the frozen M1 API contract, version 1.0.0.
Where this file and that contract disagree, the contract governs and this file is a bug.
gateDateNote: The M2 gate is no longer a fixed date. It moves day for day from Friday 21 August 2026, because five client dependencies missed that date. 2026-08-31 is the EARLIEST achievable, if everything lands Monday 24 August 2026. Each further working day of client silence moves it one further working day. See the M2 plan, section 3.1.

owners.Trevean: Trevean Spice supplies it. Content writing, photography and translation are outside the contractor's scope per the Scope document, 'Out of scope, deferred not dropped'.
owners.Shopify: Read from Trevean's Shopify Plus store once store access is provided. Not authored by anyone.
owners.Serene Labs: The contractor authors it. Structural, factual or derived, never editorial about the supply chain.

states.client_real: Supplied by Trevean and used verbatim. Complete.
states.contractor_real: Authored by Serene Labs, factually correct, complete. Structural links and system statements only.
states.placeholder_text: A string carrying the sentinel. Renders as an obvious placeholder on the page.
states.placeholder_null: Deliberately null. A fabricated value here would be a false claim about a real supply chain, so no value is invented. Dates, coordinates, prices, counts of years.
states.placeholder_media: Points at a generated placeholder asset that is stamped PLACEHOLDER, sized and weighted to the performance budget.
states.not_applicable: Does not apply to this record.

fields.label: Slug
fields.guidance: Fixed by the redirect table. Not editable: a thousand encoded tags resolve through it.

fields.label: Blend name
fields.guidance: Supplied. The five names are in the Scope document, 'The five blends'.

fields.label: Tag code
fields.guidance: Fixed by the redirect table.

fields.label: Launch tier
fields.guidance: real for the two launch blends, seeded for the other three.

fields.label: Tagline
fields.guidance: One line under the blend name. Renders above the fold at 375 px, so 120 characters is the practical ceiling even though the contract allows 200.

fields.label: Origin country
fields.guidance: Two letter ISO 3166-1 code. One code only: a blend whose stated origin spans several countries cannot be expressed in this field and needs a decision.

fields.label: Origin region
fields.guidance: Province, state or named region as Trevean wants it printed.

fields.label: Origin city
fields.guidance: City or town. Omit rather than guess.

fields.label: Farm latitude
fields.guidance: Decimal degrees, 4 decimal places. Coarse enough not to identify a private address, per the API contract. Never invented: see the placeholder convention.

fields.label: Farm longitude
fields.guidance: Decimal degrees, 4 decimal places.

fields.label: Farm map label
fields.guidance: What the pin says. For example a district name, not a street address.

fields.label: Origin story
fields.guidance: One heading plus 2 to 5 paragraphs. Block types are heading, paragraph and quote only: no HTML. The first paragraph must read as a complete opening on its own, because the Acceptance criteria document section 6.3 requires the origin story visible without scrolling.

fields.label: Story block text
fields.guidance: Per paragraph. Heading blocks 20 to 60 characters.

fields.label: Hero photograph
fields.guidance: See the image specification. 1280 by 955, 90 KB after our processing, single subject, shallow depth of field.

fields.label: Gallery photographs
fields.guidance: Below the fold, lazy loaded, counts against the 600 KB whole page image budget. Send as many or as few as you like.

fields.label: Harvest date
fields.guidance: YYYY-MM-DD. A provenance claim: never invented, left null until supplied.

fields.label: Blend date
fields.guidance: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.label: Best before
fields.guidance: YYYY-MM-DD. A food safety claim.

fields.label: Lot label
fields.guidance: Printed lot reference. Freshness is per blend, not per jar: tag encoding is per SKU so per lot attribution is impossible.

fields.label: Freshness note
fields.guidance: A statement about how the system works, not about the spice. Authored by us and correct as written.

fields.label: Grower link
fields.guidance: Structural link. The grower record behind it is a separate entity with its own fields.

fields.label: Shopify SKU
fields.guidance: From the store. Needed before the reorder button can work.

fields.label: Shopify product id
fields.guidance: gid://shopify/Product/...

fields.label: Shopify variant id
fields.guidance: gid://shopify/ProductVariant/... The cart permalink is built from it.

fields.label: Cart permalink
fields.guidance: Derived from the variant id. Static URL, zero API calls, and it is the whole one tap reorder mechanism.

fields.label: Grower name
fields.guidance: A real person or cooperative, with their consent to be named and photographed. Never invented.

fields.label: Farm or cooperative name
fields.guidance: As it should be printed.

fields.label: Grower country
fields.guidance: Two letter ISO 3166-1 code.

fields.label: Grower region
fields.guidance: Province or named region.

fields.label: Grower profile copy
fields.guidance: Below the fold. 600 to 900 characters reads as a profile rather than a caption and stays inside the page weight budget.

fields.label: Years farming
fields.guidance: A claim about a real person. Never invented, left null until supplied.

fields.label: Grower portrait
fields.guidance: See the image specification. 640 by 640, 80 KB after processing. Requires the subject's written consent.

fields.label: Farm latitude
fields.guidance: Decimal degrees. Never invented.

fields.label: Farm longitude
fields.guidance: Decimal degrees.

fields.label: Blends supplied
fields.guidance: Structural back pointer. Maintained by us, used to work out what needs republishing after a grower edit.

fields.label: Recipe title
fields.guidance: Reads on one or two lines in a carousel card at 375 px.

fields.label: Recipe summary
fields.guidance: One or two sentences on the card.

fields.label: Servings
fields.guidance: Whole number.

fields.label: Prep minutes
fields.guidance: Whole minutes.

fields.label: Cook minutes
fields.guidance: Whole minutes.

fields.label: Difficulty
fields.guidance: One of easy, medium, hard.

fields.label: Ingredients
fields.guidance: Each line is quantity, unit, item and an optional note, supplied as four separate values rather than one string, so the page can format them and a future translation does not have to parse English.

fields.label: Method steps
fields.guidance: One step per entry, up to 800 characters each. No numbering in the text: the page numbers them.

fields.label: Recipe photograph
fields.guidance: See the image specification. 600 by 450, 38 KB after processing. Optional, but a carousel of ten cards with no photographs is a weaker page than one with them.

fields.label: Carousel position
fields.guidance: Which order the carousel runs in. We will default to submission order if none is given.

fields.label: SKU
fields.guidance: Mirrored from the store on a schedule and on product update webhooks.

fields.label: Product id
fields.guidance: Mirrored.

fields.label: Variant id
fields.guidance: Mirrored.

fields.label: Price
fields.guidance: Integer minor units plus an ISO 4217 code. Never invented: a wrong price shown to a customer is worse than no price.

fields.label: Available
fields.guidance: Mirrored.

fields.label: Inventory status
fields.guidance: unknown is a legitimate value when the mirror is stale. It is not an error.

fields.label: Cart permalink
fields.guidance: Derived from the variant id.

fields.label: Source file
fields.guidance: See the image specification for dimensions, format and maximum source size.

fields.label: Alternative text
fields.guidance: Describes the photograph for someone who cannot see it. Required before an image can appear on a published page.

fields.label: Photographer credit and licence
fields.guidance: Who shot it and on what terms. Needed for the background IP list, and for a portrait, confirmation that the subject consented.

imageSpecification.$comment: Every number here is derived from the M1 performance budget deliverable and its budget.json. Changing one is a change to a contractual gate.

hero.note: The largest variant served. 90 KB is a hard cap from the performance budget: the byte cap is fixed and the photograph is chosen to fit it, not the other way round. Art direction: single subject, shallow depth of field, large simple shapes. Avoid flat lit full frame high detail texture, which is the worst case both for compression and for a 375 px screen.

grower_portrait.note: Below the fold, lazy loaded. Requires the subject's written consent.

recipe.note: 38 KB is what makes ten recipe cards fit inside the 600 KB whole page image budget alongside the hero, the portrait and the farm map.

farm_map.note: A static raster generated from the farm coordinates, not an interactive map SDK. A mapping library is 200 to 800 KB of JavaScript, which exceeds the entire deferred JavaScript budget. This is a build asset, not one of the four MediaKind values in the frozen API contract.
